notes.title: Delay Announcement of Ganyang Setan Alas! The Game
notes.content: [p]After receiving incredible feedback from our demo players and reflecting on the project's direction, we've made the decision to delay the full game release to sometime later, possibly next year. This wasn't an easy choice, but it's one we believe is necessary for delivering the best possible experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342539/3a5b2234503a617855584b75024c8f7a19dbbc14.png"][/img][/p][p]We also plan to take down [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3365340/Ganyang_Setan_Alas_The_Game_Demo/?l=indonesian"]Ganyang Setan Alas The Game Demo[/url] later on September 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]We understand this delay may be disappointing, especially for those who have been following the project from the beginning. Your support and feedback have been invaluable in helping us realize Ganyang's true potential.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience as we work to bring you a game worthy of your excitement.[/p][p]Lodhong Krupuk Interactive Game Studios[/p][p][/p][p]Follow us on instagram:[/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/lodhongkrupuk.interactive/?hl=en"]@lodhongkrupuk.interactive[/url][/p]
